Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesColdPackHours_to:
How long one fully frozen cold pack keeps a cooler cold, in game hours. Packs in the same cooler add up: three frozen packs last three times as long.
A fridge chills a pack half way, a freezer fully.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesReadingEnabled_t:
Novels, comics, magazines and newspapers have a genre, a page count and a hidden quality. A read takes real time and its relief arrives per page; books are bookmarked by title. Each character likes one genre and dislikes another, found out by reading. Finishing a book gives the Good Read moodle with a small buff matched to the genre.
Off: reading works as in vanilla. Skill books and recipe magazines are vanilla either way.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesReadingPageScale: Multiplies the time a page takes. At 1 a novel is 1.5 minutes a page and a comic or magazine half a minute, on top of the game's own Minutes Per Page option (2.0 is the default; a server that changes it changes this too). A 350-page novel is then about 9 hours, 6 with Fast Reader.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesReadingRealBookC: The chance, in percent, that a novel found in loot is a real book from before July 1993 (title and author only) instead of one of the game's own, from the same genre. 0 turns real books off.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesReadingTasteStre: How much a character's liked and disliked genres matter. At 1 a liked book does 25%% more and a disliked one half as much, both in the relief while reading and in the finishing moodle. 0 makes every genre the same; 2 doubles the difference.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesReadingMoodleSca: Multiplies how long the Good Read moodle lasts after finishing a book: at 1, a day for an ordinary novel and two for an excellent one, half a day for a comic or magazine.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesReadingRereadCom: A book you have finished still gives a fifth of its relief when it is in your liked genre: comfort reading. Off: a finished book gives nothing, as in vanilla. Other genres give nothing either way.
